data.rationale: The proposal follows the same Gutenberg → Wikipedia → Notes procedure and note template in the right order, but it opens "the top result by popularity" instead of the book matching the author, and it lists derived values (author_dates, release_date, downloads) as parameters, which blurs the true inputs (title, author). It also leaves out the "do not download" constraint and the "press Enter" detail, though a browser automation could still be built from it.
